title: October Prime Day Deal 2026: Here’s How to Get Amazon Music Unlimited for Free
summary: Get up to four months for free during Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days — save up to $52 online.
contentText:

Looking for the best way to stream unlimited music? Amazon has a deal for music lovers, especially those who want to listen to free songs and podcasts, during Prime Big Deal Days (AKA October Prime Day).

Get Amazon Music Unlimited free Trial

However, if you’re an Amazon Prime member , you can get Amazon Music Unlimited for $11.99 per month, or $119 per year, after the extended free trial is finished.

PRIME BIG DEAL DAYS

Amazon Music Unlimited

Get Amazon Music Unlimited

Get Amazon Music Unlimited for free for up to four months of service (starting at $11.99 per month afterward).

The music streaming services boasts more than 100 millions songs from thousands upon thousands of recording artists, such as Sabrina Carpenter, Chappell Roan, Olivia Rodrigo, Gracie Abrams, Ella Langley, Audrey Hobert, Billy Eilish, Charli xcx, Kendrick Lamar, Hozier, Tyla, Beyoncé, Taylor Swift, Turnstile, Geese and many others.

Additionally, Amazon Music Unlimited is streamable on Apple iPhone and Apple iPad, as well as Android smartphones and tablets. It’s also accessible through various web browsers for Mac and PC laptops, Amazon Echo smart home devices, Amazon Fire TV, Google TV, Apple TV, Roku and other devices. Learn more about Amazon Music Unlimited here .

For a limited time during Prime Big Deal Days (and beyond), you can get Amazon Music Unlimited with an extended free trial — up to four months of service for free.

Meanwhile, Amazon Music Unlimited comes with a subscription to Audible, which is now on sale for just $1 per month for three months .
